case_file.question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.
case_file.event_verification_notes: The Orvan Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026 without renewal. This is stated by a tier-1 ministry notice (ORV-0016) and confirmed by tier-2 reporting (ORV-0034, ORV-0024). The early report of a renewal (ORV-0043, tier 2, 9 Sep, unconfirmed by the ministry, citing 'people involved') was corrected and withdrawn by ORV-0013. Rumour/forecast sources ORV-0015 and ORV-0049 (tier 3, before expiry) are superseded. A separate dock strike began on 14 September (ORV-0032) and is a distinct event that overlaps in time, so the trade declines cannot be attributed wholly to the corridor ending. ORV-0004 (Vantro Trading, a company statement claiming markets have adjusted) is self-interested and not supported by the trade rows. Trade data show the Orvan wheat drop from September 2026 and the maize drop from October to November 2026 (the maize delay is explained by delayed delivery terms).

No replacement arrangement has been signed.
ended on 10 September with no renewal

In September 2026, the value was USD 17.0M and the volume was 43,000 tonnes.
